title: Adorable.
text:
Adorable.. These Wood Mini Chalkboards Signs with Support Easels are adorable. There are wood pieces, that are notched to create the easels. The mini chalkboards are cute, but I am not sure they will hold up with multiple uses.

I wouldn't use these Wood Mini Chalkboards Signs with Support Easels for a wedding unless it was for a teacher. They seem a little cheap for weddings. A casual business meeting might be a way to use them.

I do plan to get some liquid chalk to see if they look any better with better chalk. As of right now, I will not be recommending them to family or friends.
